verdict: Leads are coming in, but cost spiked and pipeline follow-through needs attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 31 leads at an average cost of $135.76 per lead — all 31 came through Meta, which is running at roughly $47 per lead on its own. The overall cost-per-lead figure looks high because Google Ads spent $2,747 this period while its conversion tracking was not recording correctly; that is a confirmed tracking issue, not a sign the ads failed, and the fix is in progress. Separately, Google Business Profile engagement dropped sharply in the last 7 days, and we're investigating whether that reflects a visibility change. The most pressing priority right now is that 31 leads entered your pipeline this period with no appointments booked and no cases marked won — leads are arriving, but the intake process is not moving them forward, and that is where focus is shifting immediately.
